title: HPL3/Resources/TDD Asset Pack
wikitext:
The [http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=570600440 Amnesia: The Dark Descent Asset Pack] has been released on Steam.

You can download it and put it in your mod to use it, but it would be recommended to instead use a [[HPL3/Modding/Mod_Dependencies|mod dependency]]. It might not be possible for Amnesia: Rebirth, because the asset pack is released as a SOMA mod.

{{todo| Test if Rebirth can use a SOMA mod as dependancy }}

Further reading: [[Hpl3:Community:other:hpl2 import|Importing HPL2 assets to HPL3]]
